words.example: Can we table this until Thursday?
words.exampleZh: 能否把这个议题先搁到周四？
我们进入人手安排这项。

words.example: Please wrap it up in two minutes.
Hold any other business until every listed item has been handled.
words.exampleZh: 请把其他事项留到所列事项都处理完之后。

words.example: Before we adjourn, is there any AOB (Any Other Business)?
words.exampleZh: 散会之前，还有其他事项吗？

words.example: Check the hash on the vendor installer before it goes on any clinic PC.
words.exampleZh: 厂商安装包装到任何门诊电脑之前，先核对哈希。

words.example: The encryption key for the archive left with the old admin and nobody else has it.
words.exampleZh: 归档的加密密钥跟着老管理员走了，别人手里都没有。

words.example: Publish the public key for the results mailbox so partner labs can encrypt files.
words.exampleZh: 把结果邮箱的公钥公布出去，合作检验所才能加密文件。

words.example: The private key for the portal certificate never leaves the application server.
words.exampleZh: 门户证书的私钥不能离开应用服务器。

words.example: The certificate chain is missing the intermediate, so browsers warn on the portal.
words.exampleZh: 证书链缺了中间证书，浏览器会在门户上报警。
